newsitem.title: USA: Remington Products says names Castaldi CFO.
newsitem.headline: Remington Products says names Castaldi CFO.

text.p: Remington Products Co LLC said on Thursday it had named Alexander Castaldi chief financial officer and executive vice president, effective November 25.
The company said he will replace Nicholas Dovidio of Vestar Capital Partners, now acting as interim CFO of Remington.
Castaldi was most recently CFO of Uniroyal Chemical Corp, which manufactures and markets specialty chemicals, the company said.
Remington Products manufactures and markets men's and women's electrical personal care appliances.
